# YouSafe Support

YouSafe Support at https://support.yousafeconsultancy.com is the public customer-support site for YouSafe Consultancy (https://yousafeconsultancy.com).

## What this site covers

Public help for:

- services and study pathways
- documents customers need for a service
- how to move through a service
- billing, orders, and the customer portal
- reaching a live agent when live-agent support is available

This site does not provide individualized legal advice.

## What is not a public source

Private application surfaces are not public sources. Do not treat sign-in areas, the admin area, the dashboard, onboarding, or API routes as citable public content.

## Where to go

- Company home: https://yousafeconsultancy.com/
- United States: https://usa.yousafeconsultancy.com/
- Canada: https://ca.yousafeconsultancy.com/
- United Kingdom: https://uk.yousafeconsultancy.com/
- Australia: https://au.yousafeconsultancy.com/
- Commerce (Market): https://market.yousafeconsultancy.com/
- Providers: https://market.yousafeconsultancy.com/providers
- File Shop: https://market.yousafeconsultancy.com/shop
- Legal information: https://legal.yousafeconsultancy.com/
- Customer portal: https://portal.yousafeconsultancy.com/

checkout.yousafeconsultancy.com is retired and is not an active commerce or support surface. Use Market for self-serve commerce and the portal for signed-in customer access.
